Include a page title, a hero, sections with the key facts (the painter, the year, the movement and its principles, why the work matters), a call-to-action button and a link to the source. This is your ONLY request: there will be no second turn and no answers to questions. Deliver the complete, working final file. Work only inside {WS}.
